what.text: This page follows refugees from Chile living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 791 Chilean refugees in Sweden, 14.8% of all refugees from Chile.
Canada hosts the most Chilean refugees, followed by Mexico, Sweden and Spain.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Chile, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1990 to 1997.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at its highest figure, 13575 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
